"""Book a table for a party on a day at a time."""

from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import date, time

from bistro.booking.models.booking import Booking
from bistro.shared.result import Ok
from bistro.booking.ports.booking_repository.booking_repository import BookingRepository
from bistro.booking.ports.table_repository.table_repository import TableRepository
from bistro.booking.ports.id_generator.id_generator import IdGenerator


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CreateBookingInput:
    table_id: str
    day: date
    start: time
    party: int
    guest: str


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class TableNotFound:
    reason: str


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PartyTooLarge:
    reason: str


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SlotTaken:
    reason: str


type CreateBookingFailure = (
    TableNotFound
    | PartyTooLarge
    | SlotTaken
)

type CreateBookingOutput = Ok[Booking] | CreateBookingFailure


class CreateBooking:
    def __init__(self, bookings: BookingRepository, tables: TableRepository, ids: IdGenerator) -> None:
        """Takes the ports it uses; main.py passes their adapters."""
        self.bookings = bookings
        self.tables = tables
        self.ids = ids

    def handle(self, input: CreateBookingInput) -> CreateBookingOutput:
        table = self.tables.get(input.table_id)
        if table is None:
            return TableNotFound(f"there is no table {input.table_id}")
        if input.party > table.seats:
            return PartyTooLarge(f"table {table.id} seats {table.seats}, not {input.party}")
        if any(b.table_id == table.id and b.day == input.day and b.start == input.start for b in self.bookings.all()):
            return SlotTaken(f"table {table.id} is booked at {input.start:%H:%M}")
        booking = Booking(id=self.ids.next_id(), table_id=table.id, day=input.day, start=input.start, party=input.party, guest=input.guest)
        self.bookings.save(booking)
        return Ok(booking)

from bistro.booking.queries.get_day_schedule import GetDaySchedule, GetDayScheduleInput, GetDayScheduleResult

from bistro.booking.models.booking import Booking
from bistro.shared.result import Ok
from bistro.booking.ports.booking_repository.booking_repository import BookingRepository
from bistro.booking.ports.table_repository.table_repository import TableRepository

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CreateBookingInput:
    table_id: str

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class TableNotFound:

@dataclass(frozen=True)

        for booking in self.bookings.all():
            if (booking.table_id == input.table_id and

            day=input.day,

"""Book a table for a party on a day at a time."""

from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import date, time

from bistro.booking.models.booking import Booking
from bistro.shared.result import Ok
from bistro.booking.ports.booking_repository.booking_repository import BookingRepository
from bistro.booking.ports.table_repository.table_repository import TableRepository
from bistro.booking.ports.id_generator.id_generator import IdGenerator


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CreateBookingInput:
    table_id: str
    day: date
    start: time
    party: int
    guest: str


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class TableNotFound:
    reason: str


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PartyTooLarge:
    reason: str


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SlotTaken:
    reason: str


type CreateBookingFailure = (
    TableNotFound
    | PartyTooLarge
    | SlotTaken
)

type CreateBookingOutput = Ok[Booking] | CreateBookingFailure


class CreateBooking:
    def __init__(self, bookings: BookingRepository, tables: TableRepository, ids: IdGenerator) -> None:
        """Takes the ports it uses; main.py passes their adapters."""
        self.bookings = bookings
        self.tables = tables
        self.ids = ids

    def handle(self, input: CreateBookingInput) -> CreateBookingOutput:
        table = self.tables.get(input.table_id)
        if table is None:
            return TableNotFound(f"there is no table {input.table_id}")

        if input.party > table.seats:
            return PartyTooLarge(f"table {table.id} seats {table.seats}, not {input.party}")

        for existing in self.bookings.all():
            if (
                existing.table_id == table.id
                and existing.day == input.day
                and existing.start == input.start
            ):
                return SlotTaken(f"table {table.id} is booked at {input.start:%H:%M}")

        booking = Booking(
            id=self.ids.next_id(),
            table_id=table.id,
            day=input.day,
            start=input.start,
            party=input.party,
            guest=input.guest,
        )
        self.bookings.save(booking)
        return Ok(booking)

    schedule = GetDaySchedule(

from bistro.shared.result import Ok
from bistro.booking.ports.booking_repository.booking_repository import BookingRepository
from bistro.booking.ports.table_repository.table_repository import TableRepository
from bistro.booking.ports.id_generator.id_generator import IdGenerator


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CreateBookingInput:
    table_id: str
    day: date
    start: time
    party: int
    guest: str

class TableNotFound:
    reason: str


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PartyTooLarge:
    reason: str


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SlotTaken:
    reason: str


type CreateBookingFailure = (
    TableNotFound
    | PartyTooLarge
    | SlotTaken
)

        self.bookings = bookings
        self.tables = tables
        self.ids = ids

    def handle(self, input: CreateBookingInput) -> CreateBookingOutput:
        table = self.tables.get(input.table_id)
        if table is None:
            return TableNotFound(f"there is no table {input.table_id}")
        if input.party > table.seats:
            return PartyTooLarge(f"table {table.id} seats {table.seats}, not {input.party}")
        for existing in self.bookings.all():
            if (
                existing.table_id == input.table_id
                and existing.day == input.day
                and existing.start == input.start
            ):
                return SlotTaken(f"table {table.id} is booked at {input.start.strftime('%H:%M')}")
        booking = Booking(
            id=self.ids.next_id(),
            table_id=input.table_id,
            day=input.day,
            start=input.start,
            party=input.party,
            guest=input.guest,
        )
        self.bookings.save(booking)
        return Ok(booking)

from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import date, time

from bistro.booking.models.booking import Booking
from bistro.shared.result import Ok
from bistro.booking.ports.booking_repository.booking_repository import BookingRepository
from bistro.booking.ports.table_repository.table_repository import TableRepository
from bistro.booking.ports.id_generator.id_generator import IdGenerator


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CreateBookingInput:
    table_id: str
    day: date
    start: time
    party: int
    guest: str


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class TableNotFound:
    reason: str


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PartyTooLarge:
    reason: str


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SlotTaken:
    reason: str


type CreateBookingFailure = (
    TableNotFound
    | PartyTooLarge
    | SlotTaken
)

type CreateBookingOutput = Ok[Booking] | CreateBookingFailure


class CreateBooking:
    def __init__(self, bookings: BookingRepository, tables: TableRepository, ids: IdGenerator) -> None:
        """Takes the ports it uses; main.py passes their adapters."""
        self.bookings = bookings
        self.tables = tables
        self.ids = ids

    def handle(self, input: CreateBookingInput) -> CreateBookingOutput:
        table = self.tables.get(input.table_id)
        if table is None:
            return TableNotFound(f"there is no table {input.table_id}")
        if input.party > table.seats:
            return PartyTooLarge(f"table {table.id} seats {table.seats}, not {input.party}")
        if any(b.table_id == table.id and b.day == input.day and b.start == input.start for b in self.bookings.all()):
            return SlotTaken(f"table {table.id} is booked at {input.start:%H:%M}")

        return Ok(booking)

from datetime import date, time

from bistro.booking.models.booking import Booking
from bistro.booking.queries.count_day_bookings import CountDayBookings, CountDayBookingsInput


class FakeBookingRepository:
    def __init__(self, bookings: list[Booking] | None = None) -> None:
        self.items = {b.id: b for b in bookings or []}

    def get(self, id: str) -> Booking | None:
        return self.items.get(id)

    def save(self, booking: Booking) -> None:
        self.items[booking.id] = booking

    def all(self) -> list[Booking]:
        return [self.items[k] for k in sorted(self.items)]

    def remove(self, id: str) -> None:
        self.items.pop(id, None)


def make_booking(id: str, day: date) -> Booking:
    return Booking(id=id, table_id="t1", day=day, start=time(19, 0), party=2, guest="Ann")

            make_booking("b", day),
            make_booking("c", date(2025, 1, 2)),
        ]
    )

            day=input.day,

from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import date, time

from bistro.booking.models.booking import Booking
from bistro.shared.result import Ok
from bistro.booking.ports.booking_repository.booking_repository import BookingRepository
from bistro.booking.ports.table_repository.table_repository import TableRepository
from bistro.booking.ports.id_generator.id_generator import IdGenerator


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CreateBookingInput:
    table_id: str
    day: date
    start: time
    party: int
    guest: str


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class TableNotFound:
    reason: str


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PartyTooLarge:
    reason: str


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SlotTaken:
    reason: str


type CreateBookingFailure = (
    TableNotFound
    | PartyTooLarge
    | SlotTaken
)

type CreateBookingOutput = Ok[Booking] | CreateBookingFailure


class CreateBooking:
    def __init__(self, bookings: BookingRepository, tables: TableRepository, ids: IdGenerator) -> None:
        """Takes the ports it uses; main.py passes their adapters."""
        self.bookings = bookings
        self.tables = tables
        self.ids = ids

    def handle(self, input: CreateBookingInput) -> CreateBookingOutput:
        table = self.tables.get(input.table_id)
        if table is None:
            return TableNotFound(f"there is no table {input.table_id}")
        if input.party > table.seats:
            return PartyTooLarge(f"table {table.id} seats {table.seats}, not {input.party}")
        
        # Check if the slot is already taken
        for booking in self.bookings.all():
            if (booking.table_id == input.table_id and 
                booking.day == input.day and 
                booking.start == input.start):
                return SlotTaken(f"table {input.table_id} is booked at {input.start.strftime('%H:%M')}")
        
        # Create the booking
        booking_id = self.ids.next_id()
        new_booking = Booking(
            id=booking_id,
            table_id=input.table_id,
            day=input.day,
            start=input.start,
            party=input.party,
            guest=input.guest
        )
        self.bookings.save(new_booking)
        return Ok(new_booking)

from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import date, time

from bistro.booking.models.booking import Booking
from bistro.shared.result import Ok
from bistro.booking.ports.booking_repository.booking_repository import BookingRepository
from bistro.booking.ports.table_repository.table_repository import TableRepository
from bistro.booking.ports.id_generator.id_generator import IdGenerator


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CreateBookingInput:
    table_id: str
    day: date
    start: time
    party: int
    guest: str


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class TableNotFound:
    reason: str


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PartyTooLarge:
    reason: str


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SlotTaken:
    reason: str


type CreateBookingFailure = (
    TableNotFound
    | PartyTooLarge
    | SlotTaken
)

type CreateBookingOutput = Ok[Booking] | CreateBookingFailure


class CreateBooking:
    def __init__(self, bookings: BookingRepository, tables: TableRepository, ids: IdGenerator) -> None:
        """Takes the ports it uses; main.py passes their adapters."""
        self.bookings = bookings
        self.tables = tables
        self.ids = ids

    def handle(self, input: CreateBookingInput) -> CreateBookingOutput:
        table = self.tables.get(input.table_id)
        if table is None:
            return TableNotFound(f"there is no table {input.table_id}")
        
        if input.party > table.seats:
            return PartyTooLarge(f"table {input.table_id} seats {table.seats}, not {input.party}")
        
        # Check if slot is taken
        for booking in self.bookings.all():
            if (booking.table_id == input.table_id and 
                booking.day == input.day and 
                booking.start == input.start):
                return SlotTaken(f"table {input.table_id} is booked at {input.start.strftime('%H:%M')}")
        
        # If we get here, the booking is valid
        booking_id = self.ids.next_id()
        new_booking = Booking(
            id=booking_id,
            table_id=input.table_id,
            day=input.day,
            start=input.start,
            party=input.party,
            guest=input.guest
        )
        self.bookings.save(new_booking)
        return Ok(new_booking)

"""Book a table for a party on a day at a time."""

from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import date, time

from bistro.booking.models.booking import Booking
from bistro.shared.result import Ok
from bistro.booking.ports.booking_repository.booking_repository import BookingRepository
from bistro.booking.ports.table_repository.table_repository import TableRepository
from bistro.booking.ports.id_generator.id_generator import IdGenerator


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class CreateBookingInput:
    table_id: str
    day: date
    start: time
    party: int
    guest: str


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class TableNotFound:
    reason: str


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class PartyTooLarge:
    reason: str


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class SlotTaken:
    reason: str


type CreateBookingFailure = (
    TableNotFound
    | PartyTooLarge
    | SlotTaken
)

type CreateBookingOutput = Ok[Booking] | CreateBookingFailure


class CreateBooking:
    def __init__(self, bookings: BookingRepository, tables: TableRepository, ids: IdGenerator) -> None:
        """Takes the ports it uses; main.py passes their adapters."""
        self.bookings = bookings
        self.tables = tables
        self.ids = ids

    def handle(self, input: CreateBookingInput) -> CreateBookingOutput:
        table = self.tables.get(input.table_id)
        if table is None:
            return TableNotFound(f"there is no table {input.table_id}")
        if input.party > table.seats:
            return PartyTooLarge(f"table {table.id} seats {table.seats}, not {input.party}")
        if any(b.table_id == table.id and b.day == input.day and b.start == input.start for b in self.bookings.all()):
            return SlotTaken(f"table {table.id} is booked at {input.start:%H:%M}")
        booking = Booking(id=self.ids.next_id(), table_id=table.id, day=input.day, start=input.start, party=input.party, guest=input.guest)
        self.bookings.save(booking)
        return Ok(booking)
